name: slack-fast-own-task-follow-through
description: A Fast coding-task launch and immediate follow-up exercise automatic bounded own-task check-in scheduling without duplicate offers or wakeups.
criteria: In the first turn, the bot acknowledges the repository fix, launches exactly one coding task, and confirms one automatic check-in in about 10 minutes without asking the user to opt into monitoring
The check-in described by the bot is scoped to the exact launched task, is one-shot and bounded, and is not presented as a recurring automation or external-process monitor
In the second turn, the bot routes the test-coverage instruction to the existing task and does not announce, offer, or schedule a second equivalent check-in

In the third turn, the bot explains that the check inspects the exact task, stays silent for completion, cancellation, already-reported or non-useful state, reports only concrete progress, blockers, or needed input, and never renews itself
The bot does not claim implementation progress, completion, test results, or a pull request that the task has not reported
Every bot reply stays in the originating Slack thread and no channel-level bot messages are posted
